title: Game night with friends
description: Block time for an online or in-person gaming session. You choose the date and time.

title: Esports team practice
description: Practice block for a campus esports team. Confirm the real session time with your team.

title: Recreation Center workout
description: Exercise block. Check official Rec Well hours before you go.

title: Focused study block
description: Protected study time before an exam or deadline.

title: Research lab meeting
description: Recurring research group meeting. Enter the time your group actually uses.

title: Part-time work shift
description: A shift at your job. KIN never contacts an employer on your behalf.

title: Family pickup / responsibility
description: A household commitment such as a pickup or appointment.

title: Detroit sports watch party
description: Your own watch-party block. KIN does not hold live Lions, Tigers, Pistons or Red Wings schedules — check the official team site for real fixture times.
